data.animaCaption: Standing atop a windswept mountain ridge above a sea of sunset clouds, she points toward the horizon as her gold-embroidered crimson cloak billows beside a blazing stone brazier.
data.camera: 全身镜头，广角云海山巅构图
data.description: 落日余晖染红云海的七丘山巅烽火台边，奥古斯塔披着金线日轮刺绣红毛领披风，山风吹起火红长发，她伸手指向远方山脊。
data.lighting: 火烧云霞光与烽火台火盆暖橙火光
data.promptProse: High above a crimson sea of sunset clouds on Septimont's ridge watchtower, Augusta gestures toward the distant peaks while the mountain wind sweeps her gold-embroidered scarlet travel cloak.
data.title: 奥古斯塔 · 云海山巅烽火台暮雪巡行
